notes.title: A whole ton of battle rebalancing!
notes.content:
This update is bring the power level of attack builds and status effect builds more in line with eachother. From launch til now, it's looked like Defence is too strong, it lets you survive physical hits and also doubles to boosting your status effects (which ignore defence too). To counteract that, I've gone through all the Critters and been reducing defence and increasing HP, some have even had further balancing. 

The aim is twofold:
[olist]
 Reduce defence so physical attacks can overall do more damage
 Reduce defence so status effects and heals take a bit more effort to stack up
[/olist]

So hopefully this update is a positive change to getting all cards a bit more balanced, and increase the viability of attack cards.
Another change was to reduce the power of the attack cards which hit all enemies. These cards were similar damage to those which hit one target which shouldn't be the case. Of course lots of other single target cards have been buffed up, but the majority are where I'd like them to be.

The final big change is swapping the rarity of the X Energy and Critter+X Energy. I'd vastly underestimated how useful a card that gave 1 energy but didn't use a Card Play was compared to 2 energy that were more flexible. Therefore, those free to use energy cards will be harder to get and the starting decks will all feature Critter+X Energy cards, which may have the added bonus of making multitype teams easier to create.

See the detailed changelist below for this update. Feel free to reach out on the Steam Forums or over on Discord if you have suggestions for this update or future updates!

Thanks for playing Isle of Swaps,

Critters

notes.title: Isle of Swaps has now released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, just to confirm that Isle of Swaps has released into v1.0 (or v1.035 specifically) so no Early Access here, the game is complete!

Please have fun on the Isle of Swaps, trading cards, ripping open booster packs and conquering everyone with your masterful battle deck. And when you make silly decks to beat the championship, I want to see them! Join the Discord and show them off.

Bundles
Isle of Swaps will be released in 2 bundles. The first is Isle of Swaps and it soundtrack. If you like the battle tunes you've heard in the demo, be sure to pick that up.
The second bundle is Isle of Swaps, Fuzz Force: Spook Squad and both of their soundtracks. Fuzz Force: Spook Squad is the first game I made and it's another roguelite deckbuilder but with dice! You'll play as ghost hunters on their journey through a board game to stop the Polter Prince. This game is the origin of Finn, Dotty, Lix, Peppa and Cassie! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/a4b6917358ffa409e19216e5e024a0ef40bc4ecb.gif

Adventure mode bonus
Now for that bonus: Did you know Isle of Swaps used to be an open-world collectathon? It didn't take off so it became the roguelite deckbuilder you know now. It was planned to be a game where Dina travelled around her island swapping cards to complete her binder, and the battles were auto battles where you assigned boosting skill cards to your critters before the fights. 
Where I'm going with this is that you can play that version too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/17b13b32b1979498a3ac1428a2fc77a62e4ce5bb.png

All you need to do is right click Isle of Swaps, select betas and then choose iosadventuremode from the dropdown. Then you can play this original version! Your roguelite version data will be safe, the original version doesn't save anything. Think of it as a free demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/239bd3a912a8e4fe9d18f1745e48613c4f1f1d56.jpg

Final Points
IF you have any issues or feedback for the game, please don't hesitate to get in touch with me on the Steam Forums or through Discord.
If you have enjoyed playing Isle of Swaps, it's so useful to leave a review for the game. When a game gets passed 10 reviews the algorithms start to show the game to more people which really helps its exposure! Though lets not stop at 10, all the way to at least 50 for that very positive rating!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swap

notes.title: Welcome to Isle of Swaps at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Isle of Swaps, I hope you've got your sunglasses, it's a wonderful day! Isle of Swaps is in the Steam Next Fest, so as a first time player, how about some tips to get you started?

In short, Isle of Swaps is a roguelite deckbuilder. You'll gain cards which go in your binder, then you'll make a battle deck that you can change at anytime. If you want new cards you'll need to swap for them from other characters when you beat them in a Critter Battle. A battle deck is made up of 3 types of cards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/6025afa9d07e5f8910e69a87dfff6fdb92d24353.png
Critter Cards
The stars of the show, you can start with either Hangolin, Wallablaze or Aguatto. Who will you choose? When deckbuilding, you can use 1-3 Critters to battle with. Each Critter is from 1 of 6 types, and those types all have unique abilities so it's going to be a tough choice choosing which types to use. Along with a type, each Critter can have a weakness and resistance which will make it take more or less damage from other Critters. You also need to keep an eye on their stats too as those will affect the Skill cards they use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/9ff4521f5bec11d6ac4ecbe4e14aed32c26f7467.png
Skill Cards
The embodiment of attacks that Critters can use. Each Critter in your deck means you need to add 6 Skill cards but it doesnt have to be 6 Skill cards per Critter. You can have 11 Skill cards of Type A and 1 of Type B. Deckbuild your way! Skill cards also have types, and they can only be used of Critters of the same element. Finally Skill cards will use the Critter's stats to modify it when it's played. Flame Tackle does Power + 9 damage, so the final damage will be your Critters Power stat +9!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/a3a7b27185c52f61ca8db06c821da4299ee01be6.png
Sticker Cards
All around buffs and passive effects are contained in these cards. Put some in your deck to power up your Critters as the challenge gets tougher. Each Sticker has a Sticker Point value, and your maximum SP will reduce when you use stronger uncommon and rare Critters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/0b99bad2a27fb14b6006302a8aedba78c8d6157b.png
Swapping
Now you know about the cards, you'll want to swap for new ones! Each time you defeat someone you'll get to swap with them and see what cards they have. You'll choose some cards with the overall Swap Value increasing with each one, then you'll offer spare cards from your binder to meet that Swap Value. Remember how when you wanted to trade you had to trade an uncommon for 1 uncommon or 2 commons? It's just like that!

Get involved!
With all this knowledge in mind, just get out there! No better way to learn than getting stuck in, choosing your first starter Critter and then taking on the playground to be the champion!
I'll be streaming playthroughs of the game 2 times this week, be sure to tune in Live and we can chat as I play. Let me know your thoughts on the demo on the Steam Forums Isle of Swaps on Steam Forums or drop right into the Discord Fuzz Force Discord

Most importantly, wishlist the game if you enjoyed yourself and tell everyone you know to get swapping!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swap

notes.title: What's your type?
notes.content:
Whilst making Isle of Swaps, I wanted there to be some important decision making in which types you use on your team, and how that would shape the playstyle of the run. I've gone for splitting each effect between the types without any overlaps, giving each type abilities unique to it. With the exception of healing because I don't want to pigeonhole you into using grass types if you want some recovery.

An exciting caveat is that a Critters' abilities are not restricted to those of its type! There's all kinds of Critter cards and I bet there's loads of combinations that aren't obvious at first. But for starters, let's break down these abilities!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/5afa06abfe47f11d9e40bc737f349b5fdd8f8071.png
Nature
Damage: Lowest
Abilities

 Poison
 Healing
 Thorns

With Nature, even though their attacks aren't the strongest, their Poison will add extra damage each turn. Paired with Healing and Thorns, they become a long lasting defensive type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/f67788b263b083690b456832d5fc7de346ec559a.png
Blaze
Damage: Highest
Abilities

 Burn
 Power Up/Down
 Critical

With high attack damage and Critical boosting it further, Blaze is the type to use to wipe out the enemy quickly. Burn gives additional burst damage, and a strong damage option for defensive Blaze Critters. Power Up will of course increase the damage you do, with Power Down lowering the damage you'll take.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/6fca57903d85a4fbf94fc61e942566942ec8b65f.png
Aqua
Damage: Lowest
Abilities

 Soak
 Healing
 Status Cure

Aqua is the second support type with both Healing and the unique ability to cure status effects from your team. Soak bolsters lower damage by splashing the damage to the other opponents with each attack giving them an advantage versus bigger Critter teams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/2f4db7d1532d01a449706faebdda6a7e8971c405.png
Volt
Damage: Middle
Abilities

 Shock
 Dodge
 Stun

Volt types specialise in preventing the enemy from landing hits. Stun the enemies to stop them acting and Dodge the attacks that do happen. To top it off, Shock will damage anyone who even tries to use a skill card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/4c2d65855616c49f32136deebe1cc5ef6b700ab5.png
Terra
Damage: Highest
Abilities

 Taunt
 Defence Up/Down

It may look like Terra only has 2 abilities but Taunt can be applied to enemies too. As Critters only attack the Critter opposite, shining a spotlight can have your whole team burst down a single opponent. Especially one with lower Defence. Or you they can Taunt themselves, raise their Defence and become a sturdy wall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/eafb9fb64c0aceb5c017f23f1c1d4b0fa913b762.png
Spectral
Damage: Middle
Abilities

 Status Immunity
 Random Buffs
 Random Debuffs

The Spectral type has access to every Status effect if you're willing to roll the dice. Buff your team with a number of buffs whilst debilitating the enemies and using Skill cards that do more to weakened enemies.

Now you know the 6 types, which 3 types will you use on your team? Or better yet, try the demo and let me know who you used!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swap

notes.title: v0.094 - Cheaper Energy
notes.content:
Game

notes.title: Demo Update v0.093: Choose Your Energy
notes.content:
I've been watching how people have been playing the game and something that's been coming up is the ability to pick the energy that the cards use.
Previously, with the game automatically picking the energy to use for cards, you could be unable to play all the cards you wanted, even if you had the energy at the start of the turn. And that kinda sucks. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/df16abec244520352c56ea1e46b97763d980e3a0.png
So I've added a little system to choose which energy you want to use, and if you don't want to bother, it's a new option in the game options! Along with that, you can now skip the binder page turning animation and enable buttons in addition to the click+drag gestures for the binder/booster packs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/f0e6b8a0c1ccdbeb3d1c4e2480474b5e4706c88c.png
Another big change expands the decks you can make with a change to the hybrid Skill Cards. These cards require 2 elements of energy to use and generally have effects from both of the types but could only be used by 1 of those types of Critter. No longer! Hybrid Skill Cards can now be used by Critters of both types! Its an idea I've been thinking on for a while and I want to give it a try, it should give loads more options to play with.

Something that's also come up a few times is dragging a skill card onto a Critter seeming finnicky. So now the Skill Card snaps over the Critter to make it much clearer when its in the right place to play.


Hows the full game coming along?
For the full game, the main systems are almost done! You can master cards, unlock new characters, enter the Critter Championship and I've made 90 more Skill Cards to try out. Considering the demo has 100 Skill Cards, thats quite the boost! I hope they work out and allow for some great play styles.

Now what are you waiting for, go try out the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swaps

notes.title: Demo update: The Rival and Sami Swaps have entered the playground
notes.content:
Hi there swappers, the demo is updated once again and this one brings some new characters and features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/c46bb570da9f518bc5811e18042f7ed32deec762.png
First up is the Rival character and Sami Swaps.
The Rival embodies a set of Special Characters, like Team Rockoon, and other characters who are more unique than the generic trainers you'll usually face. These guys are generally tougher to impose a miniboss sort of challenge and will offer better cards to swap when beaten. 
The Rival will take the Critter who is strong vs the one you choose at the start of the run and will appear in the very first hand. If you can beat him, your run will be off to a great start. From there, he appears in the second half of each act with a team featuring his starter and some other Critters he picked up along the way!

Sami Swaps isn't much for battling, he's all about those trades. Sami will place 3 individual swaps of cards that are just sat in your binder and offer an equal or better rarity of cards. You aren't using those cards, so it's totally worth swapping with him, right?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/6dbc3d83fe1bf4f5fa0dee71cfd197bcd9c2f956.png
The shop has gotten its shipment of a Signature Machine! You know how you get a skill card when you beat a Wild Critter? That's its Signature Skill and this machine will sell you the Signature Skill of any Critter you have in your binder.

Want the tailnotes of the other new features?

 Trainers will now ask for a certain type of card when you swap with them, putting this in the swap increases your swap value and lets you get good deals.
 Swapmaster Dina's ability gives her an additional 1 Swap Value for each card she offers.
 Skill Cards you can't use because the only Critter that could use them has fainted are now removed from that battle. This is to lower the frustration of unusable cards in battle.
 Losing a battle only costs a single Critter instead of all the ones you used.
 Stickers start at 10 slots and decrease based on the rarity of the Critters you use. Use less Critters to use more Stickers
 Using Critters of the same type in your Battle Deck lowers how many Skill Cards you need to add from 6 to 3 making it easier to use duplicate types.


Can I expect survival against your Rival? Head into the demo and find out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swap

notes.title: The new and improved demo is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks so much for playing and enjoying Isle of Swaps so far. The reception has been great to hear.
Before all the feedback, I want to ask if you noticed the new images around Steam for Isle of Swaps? These have been drawn by Juan Zambrano who has illustrated a load of cards for the game. Noticeably one of Dina's starters: Aguatto. (Did you pick Aguatto as your starter btw?) I love Juan's art style and with his work on the cards it was an easy choice to ask him to draw the cover art too. Even after the cards and cover art, he's still up for more cards!

So now for the main bulk of this update: I've listened to feedback and watched people play the demo and I've been working on some changes to make the game even better!
It really boils down into 2 main categories, the first is:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/9bf783a45ae564f208219480824694d440c41ef8.png

What were the problems with deckbuilding?

 Critters added 3 skills to the battle deck which meant less room for the player to customise the deck
 Players only used the 3 skills that came with the Critters and didn't add other cards or only added stickers
 The above lent itself to the strategy of having a small deck to repeatedly use the same cards
 Players wanted to use rare critters but found their available deck shrinking limited that
 Cards you wanted to use were hard to come across and required you to give up a lot to swap for them


Those are some serious issues for a deckbuilder game, huh?
Here's what I've changed and you can play with right now

 Critters no longer add skills to your deck
 For every Critter added to your battle team, at least 6 Skill Cards need to be added too
 Skill Cards and Sticker Cards have separate slots
 You start with 10 Sticker slots but the rarity of, and how many, Critters you use reduces that
 Trainers you swap with will always have at least 1 Skill Card of every type
 The value of cards has decreased so you give up less to swap
 Trainers will now ask for a specific type of card (fire critters/water skills) and your swap will be more valuable if you offer those cards
 The starter deck now has extra copies of basic Energy and Attack cards for more swap fodder
 There's a second booster pack that's cheaper and filled with basic Energy and Attack cards


So basically, all 18 slots can be used for skills, with 10 separate slots for stickers. Stickers are still reduced based on how rare your Critters are as they're more powerful. And with the changes to swapping, it should be way easier to find cards you can use and then feel less punishing to get them.


But that's not all! There have also been some changes to:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/f298146c8d52858b9be45bbd53227656913b83cd.png

This is really just 1 big change and that is that Defence now benefits Status Effects. This stemmed from defensive Critters not needing any Skill Cards to do well. They essentially worked as punching bags and due to (usually) low Power, they didnt need to attack. And conversely, every Critter could use Status Effects equally well, so a high Power Critter is good at damage and Status Effects.

Exactly how attack cards use Critters Power + a damage value on the card, Skill Cards that inflict status effects now add the Critters Defence to that. Defence now boosts Heals and stacks of Burn, Soak, Shock and Poison. If you look at the header, Prinleaf has 5 Defence (and 2 Power), and the Healing Petals card now Heals [Defence+3], so a Prinleaf using this heals 8 damage to her team!

Now high Defence Critters are usable as Status Effect appliers which I hope adds more variety to team building.

Another impactful update is how Power and Defence are changed throughout the battle. Before Power and Defence either went up by 2 or down by 2 and that buff lasted X amount of turns. But now it's a sliding scale between -3 and +3 for 3 turns. This means if you gain +1 Power from a card it'll last for 3 turns. Use the card again and you'll have +2 Power with the effect refreshing back to 3 turn duration.

Hungry for more changes?

 Dina's ability is different: Any card she offers for a swap has increased value. Swapmaster!
 When one of your Critters is defeated all cards of its element are removed from your deck (if you dont have another Critter of the same type). No more dud hands.
 Losing battles only takes 1 Critter off you, instead of your whole team
 Skill Cards now replace the [Power +3]/[Defence +1] etc on the card with the correct number when you hover the card over a Critter
 Spot Effects now stack if the card is played again
 The Battle Deck can be edited in the Shop and during Swaps
 The Battle Deck orders your cards by type
 Each type is weak to 2 other types. It's now easier to know what the enemy is potentially weak to
 Status Effect tooltips show up wherever the cards do
 All the buttons have text on them to help playing


It's a huge list and there's still more! If you want to see all the changes that have gone into the demo then you can see the patch notes here

Give it a try and tell me what you think of this update! 
Play the demo today and wishlist for Isle of Swaps.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swaps

notes.title: The Huge demo update patch notes!
notes.content:
It's been just over a month since the demo launched and I've been beavering away in that time improving the game based on what you've been saying. To see the broad strokes, click here to see the main changes to this update.

Here's the full list in the detailed bullet point format

GAME UPDATES

 -Each Critter adds no skill cards to the deck
 -Winning a Wild Critter fight gives both the Critter and a Skill Card (a skill card that wouldve been attached to them)
 -NPCs now offer more cards for swapping
 -NPCs now have at least 1 skill card of each type so they'll always have something you may want
 -NPCs will always offer a common/uncommon of each type with a chance of an additional rare
 -The Battle deck now requires you to add 6 skill cards for each Critter you add (1=6 deck cards total/ 2=12 deck cards total/ 3=18 deck cards total)
 -Stickers are now given their own slots starting at 8 stickers and reducing based upon the rarity of critters you're using 
 -The player now starts with 3 copies of each energy and attack card. Assuming 2 is the most a player would usually need, this frees up more swapping fodder
 -The Enerttack Pak has been added to Booster Machines which contain energy cards and the basic attack cards
 -With the addition of the Enerttack Pak, energy and basic attack cards have been removed from the regular booster pack
 -Uncommon cards are now worth 2 (Swap Value/Money), Rare cards are now worth 6 (Swap Value/Money)
 -Heal, Burn, Poison, Shock, Soak are now affected by the Critters Defence
 -Except on common cards where it remains a static value
 -Status effects based on turns like power/defence up/down, taunt, stun/dodge/immunity etc are unaffected
 -The aim of this is to make defensive Critters more useful in battle as they become more proficient at healing and using status effects
 -Power and Defence changes are now on a sliding scale of -3 to +3 and all those buffs/debuffs last 3 turns
 -Instead of the length of power/defence up/down, the cards now change in intensity
 -Cards from your hand update their text when hovering them over a Critter to show how much damage or status effect will be done
 -Cards that the enemy will use will always show these updated numbers
 -Burn damage no longer spreads on reaching 5 burn
 -Reduced Soak damage from 2 to 1
 -Additional description of Stickers on the Stickers page of the battle deck
 -Removed the Swap buttons on the overworld. Pointless
 -The wild Critters you find are now properly based on the progress through act. No more wild Rares in act 1.
 -The Trainers will now use their battle team from the next act if you're using more Critters than they are to bump up the challenge.
 -The starter deck now has an additional skill card that generates energy+does an effect in it.
 -Each element type now only has 2 weaknesses to make it easier to counterpick trainers
 -Opponents now have a certain type of card they want and your swap value will be boosted if you offer those to them
 -Dina's ability now works. She gains +1 Swap value on every card swapped. Wow!
 -Enemies now use more skill cards in Act 2 and 3 so the game should be a bit tougher
 -Having a critter get defeated now removes all skill cards of its element from the battle (if its the only one left of that type)
 -This can lead to a very specific situation where all skill cards are removed, and the player just loses in this scenario
 -Losing a battle now only takes 1 critter card and a life from you instead of all critters.
 -The binder contents buttons now skip to the first card you own from that category (if you own a card in that category)
 -The battle deck can now be viewed and edited whilst swapping
 -There are now 10 sticker slots. Commons reduce it by 1, uncommon by 2, rares by 3. Players using 1 or 2 Critters should get more Stickers, right?
 -Spot effects now stack
 -The battle deck now orders the cards based on elements
 -Buttons now have text on them for clarity


CRITTER UPDATES

 -Striqual HP reduced from 40 to 30. Ability changed from On hit:+1 Power to On Attack: +1 Power
 -Zappen ability changed from 2 to 1 dodge in line with dodge having a 1 stack max
 -Hangolin reduced from 3 Thorns to 2 Thorns
 -Aguatto is now 5 Pow 1 Def from 4 Pow 2 Def
 -Aguatto starts with Moat instead of Water Shield
 -Alerte gains 4 Taunt on Battle Start
 -Alertle now has 34HP, 2 Power, 2 Defence
 -Fledgee now gains 1 Status Immunity every 3 Turns
 -Fledgee now has 32HP, 3 Power, 2 Defence
 -Kinecoo changed to 38HP, 6 Pow, 0 Def and a new ability to get 1 Status Immunity every turn


SKILL UPDATES

 -Made sure cards only gave 1 stun/dodge/status immunity
 -Tsunami and Mind Blast have had their damage lowered as theyre AoE skills
 -Thunderstorm damage reduced to 5, one neutral energy added to energy cost
 -Meteor has had damage lowered as its also AoE but now also gives 1 Burn to all enemies
 -Terra Attack now correctly set to Power + 4 Damage (was +3)
 -Stunning Zap now does Power +0 damage to all enemies in addition to stunning all enemies and now costs 4 energy
 -Taunt reduced from 3 turns of Taunt to 2
 -Soak Spot Soak each turn reduced from 2 to 1
 -Power Up Whack reduced from 2 Power Up to 1
 -Drench reduced from 2 Defence Down to 1
 -Burn Up reduced from 2 Power Up to 1
 -Heal Spot reduced from 5HP per turn to 3HP
 -Big Hit energy increased from 3 to 4
 -Wildfire energy cost increased from 2 to 3
 -Reverted the change to the basic attacks damage. All of those are +1 damage
 -Moat changed from Allies to All Allies, Heal reduced to Def+1
 -Healing Drink now heals All Allies and for 2HP instead of 3HP
 -Rescue now affects All Allies
 -Take Root now deals Poison and Shock to all enemies for nature/volt/any/any energy


BUG FIXES

 -Fixed a bug where the top card of the swap pile would be replaced with the equipped skill card
 -You can no longer swap with characters who dont have any cards left to swap
 -Fixed cards where the attack was listed second not working properly
 -Fixed cards that hit twice (barrage/geode smash) not working properly
 -Aqua Attack is properly increased by power
 -Heat Rash properly applies damage based on power and burn based on defence
 -Fixed swapped hand cards having a deep sfx and the swap sfx being really deep on them
 -Fixed power and defence changes not wearing off properly
 -Fixed the Battle UI elements flying away if the button was spammed making them shake around

notes.title: Let's meet some Critters
notes.content:
Welcome to the Dina's Critter Card Academy!
Today I'd like to introduce you to some of the Critters that'll you'll be collecting in the Critter Card TCG. There'll also be some discussion about the Critter's abilities and how you can use them in battles.


First up is Alertle
These small critters live in packs inside of dark caves. They communicate through their bioluminescent shells. It's said they have up to 50 different signals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/551a78aca3561741ce1856f7d3140ff11b3f4b40.jpg
As a Terra type Critter, Alertle's have a good defence of 5. Everytime they are attacked, the damage taken is reduced by 5. Wow! Alertle's sure are great at staying in a Critter Battle.

Next up we have Ursignal
A young bear that's a bit wobbly on its feet due to constantly receving radio waves through its ears. However it can control small household appliances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/d66613ecc5cf386d843ed4c1b32dbee2e8e372ce.jpg
On the other hand, Ursignal is more focused on attacking. A Critter's attack value is made up of it's Power and Attacks per Turn. Ursiginal will do 2 damage, 4 times on its turn! Attacking many times can be useful but with a lower Power value, high defence Critters can totally shut them down.

Taking it a step further is Tweesk
A chick that lashes out with it's whisk shaped vine tail. All 3 vines attack at once for a triple slap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/8c39098923eeaab9baf2b25d46ea7f2aa1e635af.jpg
Some Critters will come with abilities that will activate on a variety of conditions. Tweesk will heal 2HP when it attacks. Since it attacks twice per turn, it'll recover 4HP. If only Tweesk could attack even more times, it'd be invincible!

Lastly lets look at Baaroola
Kept on farms for the purity of the water that surrounds them. It's easy to tell when one is sick as it has less water surrounding it. The water makes a good cushion in battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/6459dce33f0193b2678d47584c4231f600fbaeb8.jpg
Baaroola is another defensive focused Critter however its ability will benefit its teammate! Everytime Baaroola is attacked, its ally will recover health, no matter how much damage it takes. Perhaps you can plan a strategy around Baaroola's ability?


That's all for this edition of Dina's Critter Card Academy. Tune in for the next one by wishlisting Isle of Swaps.
See you next time!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swaps

notes.title: Set sail for the Isle of Swaps
notes.content:
Welcome to the Isle of Swaps, a chill trading card game where the focus is on collection, rather than battling.
With merely a Starter Deck of 6 cards inside your brand new binder begin your adventure to collect the full set of Critter Cards. But how can you achieve such a monumental task?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/d13606b4442fe1c544c4d1d0343f3e3f21801e73.png

Loads of ways!

 Get swapping! Choose some cards you NEED from someone, and offer up your own for a trade.
 Buy Booster Packs. Booster machines have been installed over the island, pop in some coins and get random cards back
 Buy the card outright. Check out the card store run by the Ferret Sisters: Ferrety and Ferrlicity. They may have one or two cards you can't get anywhere else.
 Just on the ground. People are really losing their Critter Cards?
 Check out special events. Critters: The First Movie has released and the cinema has some exclusive cards
 Battling. Well, not battling exactly, but people may only swap with you if you best them in battle first.


This relaxing island lets you take things at your own pace. Starting at school, you're allowed to run about in any direction and start getting cards straight away. There's loads of people to meet, and cards to find, so get out there!
The only true end of the game is collecting all the cards, so take it easy. You don't need to be a master battler.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/9edcbb7ca7c7be61380c2d9690f28503163f8b43.png

But speaking of battles, Critter Battles are half deckbuilding and half auto battle. Set up your battle deck using 2 Critter Cards and 6 Support Cards to bolster your Critters.
In the first half of battle, you'll be able to assign 4 Support Cards to your Critters. But the other 2 cards are shown to your opponent and they'll get to discard them from play. So you need to build a balanced battle deck, just incase your single powerful card is discarded!


Fancy starting your collection? Wishlist the game today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swaps

This game was inspired by my childhood when Pokemania was at its peak and Pokemon cards took over the school playground. Everyone was swapping and collecting them every break time. Was your childhood the same?
